In this video we will cover how Suvendu Adhikari went from being Mamata Banerjee’s close aide to becoming the biggest reason behind BJP’s rise in West Bengal. From the 2007 Nandigram movement, Bhoomi Uchhed Pratirodh Committee, and TMC’s growth, to Suvendu’s fallout with Mamata Banerjee, Abhishek Banerjee, and Prashant Kishor, this video explains the complete political shift step by step. We will also cover how Suvendu joined BJP in front of Amit Shah, attacked TMC’s “Tolabaaj Bhaipo” politics, defeated Mamata Banerjee in Nandigram, and eventually became the first BJP Chief Minister of West Bengal. This is the story of how Mamata’s own right hand man became BJP’s biggest weapon in Bengal.

We will also break down BJP’s Bengal strategy including Hindutva politics, infiltration issue, Bangladesh border debate, Sandeshkhali controversy, Murshidabad violence, RG Kar Medical College case, corruption allegations against TMC, Hindu vote consolidation, booth level planning, Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls, and BJP’s welfare promises like Ayushman Bharat and UCC. The video also covers how BJP increased its vote share from 38% in 2021 to around 45.84% in 2026, how Suvendu Adhikari became BJP’s main Hindu face in Bengal, and how BJP managed to end TMC’s long political dominance in the state.
